messages.text: Well, 2 days now still have not heard from the team?
Handed to the team · Flagged Oct 14 about HeliumDeploy App access, customer has had no reply in two d

Sorry for the silence, that's on us.

One answer I can give you now: the Bitaxe Gamma 602 runs on a MEANWELL LRS-50-5, 5V 10A. That's the supply our 602 units ship with, so any LRS-50-5 will do. Note they leave the factory trimmed a touch low, around 4.7V at the board is normal.

The App access question is back with the team, they pick it up tomorrow from 10am ET and the answer goes to your email.
yes, was wanting a price, so I could order one.  But again, you say they will get with me, and they do not.
Searched the catalog · power supply PSU replacement

I checked the live catalog: we don't sell that supply on its own, so there's no price I can give you. The only PSU we list is the Mean Well LRS-350-12 inside the $59.99 Overclocking kit, and that's 12V, wrong for a 602.

The part you want is a Mean Well LRS-50-5 (5V 10A). It's a standard Mean Well unit, so Amazon or any electronics supplier has it, usually around twenty dollars.

Sorry you had to ask twice for that.
I know, I just got the upgrade kit in.

Good, that one's the LRS-350-12. Just don't put it on the 602, that board wants 5V and 12V would cook it. The kit's supply is for the 12V units, and the heatsinks and paste are fine on anything.

Worth saying once: overclocking voids the warranty on the unit you run it on.

Which miner are you putting the kit on?
The heat sinks on a supra, so far, and I was going to hook the psu, to a thor 2.
